messages:
sam-cs: FYI - Klotho Technologies renewal window is next week. They want to shorten from 12mo to 9mo, ask for a 9% discount, and need EU vendor code on PO. Onboarding ~72% (only data-schema validation + KMS attestation outstanding). DocuSign failing for their procurement system. Need pricing/revenue handling, legal on KMS clause, and an e-sign fallback. cc @pablo-fin @tess-legal

neha-se: Thanks Sam. Seat count? Expected ramp? Any perf ops needed during ingest?

sam-cs: Starting 22 seats, expect +2 by month 2. They requested temporary Dedicated during the first 2 weeks of cutover.

pablo-fin: Baseline $145/seat/mo. Quick math: 22 * 145 * 9 = 28,710 pre-discount. 9% discount => 26,106 total. If billed monthly that'd be 2,900.67/mo after discount. Need PO + billing entity and vendor code to confirm. Also confirm if discount is applied pro-rata or single line item.

tess-legal: We can accept customer-managed KMS subject to KMS addendum and attestation. I'll draft a 9mo addendum and include signature fallback language: "If third-party e-sign is blocked by customer IT, customer may upload a wet-signed PDF via secure portal and notify LegalOps." Need signatory name/title on PO.

neha-se: Recommend provisioning temporary Dedicated capacity for cutover window. Ops can do a 2-week reservation; flag as cost uplift if they request extension.

sam-cs: Customer replied: procurement system blocks DocuSign. They'll upload a wet-sign and wire payment. PO ETA EOD Thu. They're okay with temporary Dedicated.

pablo-fin: Wire is fine. Please ensure PO includes billing entity and VAT where applicable. Finance prefers single upfront invoice for 9mo if they can wire; otherwise monthly Net30 with card is acceptable.

ryan-enable: I'll schedule admin + technical enablement the week after sign (week of 2026-05-11). Need final SSO metadata and sample schema by 2026-05-04 to prep labs. Also requested a short admin runbook update.

tess-legal: Draft addendum posted to contract repo: https://contracts.redwood.com/drafts/KLOTHO-1767779000 v1  includes KMS addendum and signature fallback.

esign-bot: DocuSign: Envelope 0x1b7 created by sam-cs  Status: failed (procurement policy block)

sam-cs: Plan recap: 1) Legal to finalize 9mo addendum + KMS clause by EOD; 2) Finance to confirm invoice cadence & wire template; 3) Enablement scheduled week after sign; 4) Neha to reserve temporary Dedicated capacity for cutover window; 5) Sam to update renewal tracker on PO upload. Closing loop here once PO & signed docs are in.
